description: This source file exports helper functions related to managing provider authentication environment variables for plugin runtimes, by re-exporting functions from another module.

methods.name: getProviderEnvVars
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables related to provider authentication.

methods.description: Lists known environment variable names used for provider authentication.

methods.description: Removes specified environment keys in a case-insensitive manner.
